_about: Snowfall Skate sounds, on blal1's genny, written by tools/snowfall_skate_sounds.py. A frozen pond at night: your blades and your partner's, lanterns burning and chiming, drifts and thin ice, spins, the snow coming down, and the Frost Fair's stalls. Music is a live medley of an original waltz and public-domain tunes, with fixed renders for the title and pause.

sounds._about: The pond at night, looped: a still hush, a breath of wind over the ice, the village far off.
Snow coming down, looped: a soft fine hiss. The game turns it up as the snow lies deeper.
The frozen river at the fair, looped: a crowd along the banks, laughter, boots on the ice.
Your blades on clear ice, looped: long gliding strokes, left and right.
Your blades in settled snow, looped: the same strokes, muffled and crunching.
Your partner's blades, looped: a lighter pair of strokes a little ahead.
A lean taken up: one carving stroke of the blade.
The push-off: a dig of the blade, a long first glide and a harp lift.
One stride: a quick push of the blade.
A lantern burning ahead, looped: a small flame crackling in its glass.
The wrong lantern taken: a flat glassy clink and a low note.
A lantern gone by: its flame slipping past behind you, and a low falling note.
A drift ahead, looped: blown snow hissing over a soft heap.
Thin ice ahead, looped: the ice ticking, creaking and pinging under strain.
Into a drift: a soft crunch of snow and a slow slide.
The ice cracks under you: a sharp crack running away through the ice.
A spin winding, looped while the key is held: blades turning on the spot, faster.
A spin ready: a rising glassy shimmer. Let go now.
A spin landed: a clean scrape out of the turn and a bright ring.
A wobble: the blades scuffing as you stagger out of the spin.
The snow has covered the ice: a hush, the wind dropping, and a low harp settling.
A course skated to its end: a long glide to a stop and a harp run up.
A night with a star: flute and celesta over the waltz bass.
No star this night: the clarinet drifts down.
A chestnut stall, looped: roasting chestnuts popping and hissing on a brazier.
A cider stall, looped: a kettle on the boil and mugs clinking.
A little band on the bank, looped: a hurdy accordion and a bass drum.
A gingerbread stall, looped: paper bags rustling and a crowd chatting close by.
A landed spin's harp sweep up.
Menu move: a light tick of a blade.
Menu select: a short glide and a celesta note.
Menu back: a soft pat of snow.
A lantern lights: a soft bell on G4, the lantern's own note.
A lantern taken: a bright chime on G4 as you skate through its glow.
A lantern lights: a soft bell on A4, the lantern's own note.
A lantern taken: a bright chime on A4 as you skate through its glow.
A lantern lights: a soft bell on B4, the lantern's own note.
A lantern taken: a bright chime on B4 as you skate through its glow.
